description: TinyFish helps ChatGPT answer web questions and complete user-directed browser workflows. It can search the web, read specific pages, and run a live browser session for tasks that require interaction, such as navigating a site, clicking, filling forms, checking page state, or working inside a web app. Use it for specific requested tasks; it is not for broad crawling, bulk URL processing, or unspecified third-party access.
